projects.name: Warbot / Metabot
projects.description: Metabot (prev. Warbot) is a RTS inspired multiplayer game made with Unity, where users create a team of agents (tanks, scout...). The agents behaviour can be written in a behaviour tree, inside the project interface, and than you can battle against another player team. Those agents are automated, following behaviour inspired by agent oriented programming.

projects.name: Mosaic
projects.description: A simple CPP project made during my Master, using color profiles and histograms to generate a mosaic of an image, using the average, than an histogram distance (Chi²) of a database.

projects.name: Exoplanets Odyssey
projects.description: A 2D game inspired by games like Starbound or Terraria, made with Unity. User can switch from star to star, and explore the multiple planets on each. This game had a serious game side, learning about Astronomy.

projects.name: C++ and QT 2D game
projects.description: Roguelike based on lighting and shaders made with OpenGL.

projects.name: Les Couleurs
projects.description: Virtual Reality platformer using Unity Engine. Game was made as a project for VR courses. Despite being an original idea, climbing the tower, especially speedrunning, could lead to arm pains.

projects.name: Agent oriented programming project
projects.description: Panic in crowds using NetLogo. Setup walls, fire and agents behaviour, and study their behaviours. Can work with or without A* movement algorithm.

projects.name: This website
projects.description: This website was created using ReactJS (vitejs), and nodejs afterwards for the backend. Components are mainly taken from antd, or javascript. AI Coding tools have been used for some parts (Codex and Code claude), in order to test such tools and determine how useful they may be. Colors are inspired by the cedar red, such a color meaning prosperity and happiness in the culture. The website was created to host tools for my studies of Japanese, share tools for my Pokemon role playing game, host tools for the Weiss Schwarz trading card game, and host this project webpage.

projects.description: Set of python tools to create a database of PTU Pokemon RPG moves, abilities and pokemons from various sources. The database is used for generating PDF sheets, or fill the website database.
